pipes.guideTitle: Comprehensive Guide: Planning and Installation of K Aqua PP-R & PPRCT Piping Systems
pipes.guideText:
Comprehensive Guide: Planning, Materials Science and Installation of K Aqua PP-R & PPRCT Piping Systems

Choosing the right pipe material is the crucial foundation for the longevity, operational safety, and energy efficiency of modern building and industrial infrastructures. Manufactured in Germany (Waldsolms), our PP-R and PPRCT piping systems offer the future-proof alternative to conventional metal pipes made of copper, steel, or brass, thanks to their excellent thermal, chemical, and mechanical properties.

Whether in domestic engineering for potable water and heating networks, in industrial plant construction, in cooling systems, or in shipbuilding, K Aqua pipes stand for uncompromising German engineering and guarantee an absolutely leak-free and maintenance-free operation for decades.

Material Innovation: PP-R and PPRCT in direct comparison

While standard Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R) already has excellent properties regarding corrosion resistance and hygiene, the further developed PPRCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymer with Modified Crystallinity Temperature resistance) sets new standards in piping technology. Through a targeted modification of the crystal structure in the polymerisation process, PPRCT offers significantly higher compressive strength at elevated operating temperatures up to 95°C.

This material advantage makes it possible to manufacture pipes with significantly lower wall thicknesses (higher SDR classes) at the same nominal pressure. The results for the user are outstanding:

  • Increased hydraulic flow: A larger internal diameter increases the flow volume by up to 17% compared to standard PP-R pipes.
  • Reduced pipe weight: The saving of material significantly simplifies transport and handling on site.
  • Higher pressure reserves: Maximum safety reserves even at peak loads in continuous hot water use.

Fibre Composite Technology (K-Fiber) for minimal linear expansion

A central aspect when planning hot water and heating pipes is the thermal linear expansion of plastic pipes. K Aqua addresses this challenge with the innovative K-Fiber composite technology. The three-layer K-Fiber pipes have a middle polypropylene layer reinforced with high-strength glass fibres.

This mechanical stabilisation reduces the linear coefficient of thermal expansion to exactly 0.035 mm/(m·K), which corresponds to a reduction in thermal linear expansion of around 75% compared to unreinforced solid plastic pipes. For specialist planners and installers, this means:

  • Fewer expansion compensators: Significant savings in bending legs and expansion loops in the pipeline route.
  • Greater fixing distances: Saving of pipe clamps and fixed points in route planning.
  • Dimensionally stable routing: No sagging of pipes in open routes or risers.

Homogeneous Polyfusion Welding: Leak tightness for 50+ years

The heart of the K Aqua piping system is the permanent, cohesive connection technology via thermal polyfusion. During the welding process, the pipe end and the socket of the fitting are heated to exactly 260°C using an electronically controlled welding device. The polymer chains of both components melt at the joining surfaces.

When joined together, the melted macromolecules interlock completely at the molecular level. After cooling, a homogeneous, monolithic material structure is formed without seams, adhesives, or elastic seals. Because no rubber O-rings or mechanical press connections are used, aging damage, resinification, or brittleness of seals are a thing of the past. The welded joint withstands the same pressures as the pipe itself.

Hydraulics, Hygiene and Environmental Compatibility

Potable water safety and energy efficiency are top priorities at K Aqua. The mirror-smooth inner surface of our PP-R and PPRCT pipes has an extremely low roughness of only k = 0.007 mm. This effectively prevents the adhesion of limescale deposits (incrustation) and stops the formation of breeding grounds for biofilms and Legionella.

In addition, the material polypropylene is physiologically completely harmless, tasteless and odourless, and free of heavy metals and plasticisers. K Aqua piping systems are certified worldwide according to the strictest testing standards (including DVGW, KIWA, WRAS). The system is also ecologically convincing: The polymer is 100% recyclable and has an excellent ecological footprint in the manufacturing process compared to metal pipes.

Important routing and planning instructions

To ensure flawless function over the guaranteed lifespan of 50 years, the following points must be observed during installation:

  • Pressure testing: After completion of the installation, the pipe network must be subjected to a pressure test according to DIN 1988 / DIN EN 806.
  • Thermal insulation: Pipes for hot water and heating must be professionally insulated according to the applicable energy saving ordinances (e.g. GEG) to minimise heat loss.
  • UV protection: When routed exposed outdoors, UV-protected pipes must be used or suitable covers provided.

faq.q: What is the difference between PPRCT and conventional PP-R in piping systems?
faq.a: PPRCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymer with Modified Crystallinity Temperature resistance) has a specially modified crystal structure that allows for higher compressive strength at elevated operating temperatures. This allows thinner-walled pipes to be used at the same nominal pressure, increasing the internal diameter and hydraulic flow capacity by up to 17%.

faq.q: How does K-Fiber composite technology reduce thermal linear expansion?
faq.a: Our K-Fiber pipes have an integrated middle layer of glass-fibre reinforced polypropylene. This layer mechanically stabilises the pipe and lowers the expansion coefficient to approx. 0.035 mm/(m·K). This corresponds to a reduction in thermal linear expansion of 75% compared to standard plastic pipes.

faq.q: Are K Aqua PP-R piping systems certified for potable water?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua piping systems meet the strictest testing and hygiene requirements of international certification bodies such as DVGW, KIWA, and WRAS. The material is completely harmless, tasteless and odourless, and effectively prevents limescale and biofilm formation.

faq.q: How is an absolutely leak-free welded joint created?
faq.a: The connection is made by thermal polyfusion at 260°C. The pipe and fitting fuse at the molecular level into a homogeneous, inseparable unit. Since no error-prone rubber seals or press fittings are used, the weld seam remains completely tight for over 50 years.

faq.q: What pressure classes and dimensions are available for K Aqua pipes?
faq.a: K Aqua offers piping systems in pressure classes SDR 6, SDR 7.4, SDR 9, and SDR 11 (PN10 to PN25) as well as in outer diameters from 20 mm to 250 mm. This makes it possible to implement both finely branched floor distributions and massive main and riser pipes.

The advantages of homogeneous welding are undisputed:

  • Flow optimisation: Our fittings are designed to maintain the cross-section at the joints. This minimises turbulence and reduces the energy consumption of circulation pumps.
  • Highest material quality: The use of premium Polypropylene Random Copolymer achieves outstanding chemical and thermal resistance that goes far beyond normative requirements.

The precise control and isolation of material flows is essential in modern water and heating networks. K Aqua shut-off valves and fittings combine the longevity of polypropylene with the precision of metallic sealing and actuating mechanisms.

What you need to know when integrating PP-R valves:

  • Dead-space-free design: To avoid water stagnation and contamination (e.g. Legionella), our valves are designed to be flow-optimised and hygienic, making them ideal for sensitive potable water installations.
  • Pressure and temperature stability: The solid valve bodies and high-quality brass or PP balls ensure a 100% seal, even with extreme pressure surges and high flow temperatures.
  • Ease of maintenance: Even after many years of continuous use, K Aqua ball valves and angle seat valves can be operated smoothly and precisely thanks to Teflon-coated sealing elements.

To maximise plant availability, we recommend strategically positioning the valves during the planning phase to enable maintenance work and flushing processes without extensive network interruptions.

weldInSaddles.guideTitle: Installation Guide: Flexibility through Weld-in Saddles
weldInSaddles.guideText:
Modifying or expanding existing industrial and commercial pipe networks is often associated with high effort. K Aqua weld-in saddles offer an efficient and extremely secure solution for creating subsequent branches without interrupting the line.

The key technical advantages at a glance:

  • Minimal installation time: Instead of severing the main pipe and installing conventional tees, the pipe is simply precisely drilled and the saddle welded on. This drastically reduces installation costs.
  • Preservation of system integrity: Through polyfusion, the weld-in saddle connects inseparably to the pipe wall, whereby the system retains its original pressure and temperature resistance (up to PN 25).
  • Flexible connection options: Available as a pure plastic branch or with an integrated metal thread (F/M), saddles enable the direct connection of sensors, pressure gauges, or branch lines in tight spaces.

To ensure a flawless weld, the use of the special K Aqua drilling and welding tools is strictly required, as they guarantee the exact milling depth and heating surface for a perfect connection.

accessories.guideTitle: Expert Advice: K Aqua Accessories for standard-compliant installations
accessories.guideText:
A high-quality piping system requires equally high-quality accessories. The K Aqua range includes all the essential components to ensure longevity, safety, and compliance with all building physics standards.

The most important aspects regarding the correct use of our accessories:

  • Compensation for linear expansion: Plastic pipes expand with temperature changes. The targeted use of our thermodynamic pipe clamps as fixed and sliding supports safely absorbs these movements and protects the system from damaging internal stresses. This is of crucial importance particularly in industrial plants and risers, where uncontrolled expansion could lead to structural damage.
  • Tight flange connections: For transitions to large valves, pumps, or tanks, our loose flanges and the precisely matched EPDM flat gaskets offer absolute safety with high contact pressures and continuous vibrations. They guarantee a seamless, liquid-tight connection, thus preventing potentially disastrous leaks in critical infrastructures.
  • Repair solutions: With our innovative repair plug, accidentally drilled pipes (e.g. on construction sites) can be homogeneously welded in minutes so that the pipe regains its full mechanical resilience. A complete replacement of the pipe section is therefore unnecessary.

In addition to compensation and leak tightness, insulation and fire protection play a central role in professional installation. The K Aqua accessories range is designed to minimise thermal losses and meet the highest safety standards. Our special seals and fasteners are designed to effectively dampen sound transmission and prevent structure-borne noise propagation in the masonry.

By exclusively using original K Aqua accessories, you secure the full system warranty and avoid cost-intensive defects caused by incompatible third-party products. Invest in uncompromising quality to guarantee the trouble-free operation of your piping system for decades.

faq.q: Are the accessories suitable for cold and hot water?
faq.a: Yes, our accessories such as pipe clamps and flat gaskets are designed for use in cold water, hot water, and heating systems and exhibit excellent thermal stability.

faq.q: Can I use accessories from third-party providers?
faq.a: In order to claim the full K Aqua system warranty, it is mandatory to use original accessories. Third-party components can lead to leak issues or mechanical failures.

faq.q: Are there special accessories for industrial use?
faq.a: Yes, our range includes heavy-duty loose flanges with a steel core, special EPDM gaskets, and reinforced pipe clamps that can easily withstand extreme industrial loads.

tools.guideTitle: Practical Guide: Pro tools for K Aqua pipe assembly
tools.guideText:
The quality of a plastic pipe installation stands and falls with the precision of the tools used. K Aqua welding and cutting tools are specifically tailored to the thermoplastic properties of PP-R and PPRCT to achieve flawless results.

Why professional equipment is indispensable:

  • Flawless preparation: An absolutely square and burr-free cut is the basic prerequisite for a tight weld. Our pipe cutters and cold circular saws prevent material compressions and microcracks.
  • Thermodynamic precision: The microprocessor-controlled socket welding devices keep the ideal joining temperature of 260°C constant even in adverse weather conditions, which reliably prevents degradation of the polymer.

items.title: Cavitation Resistance
items.desc: The flow-optimised internal geometry of our fittings effectively prevents pressure drops and cavitation, even at extreme flow velocities in industrial risers. This minimises noise emissions and protects the system from abrasive wear from the inside.

hero.title: PP-R & PPRCT Pipes from d20 to d630
hero.lead: K Aqua PP-R pipes and PPRCT multilayer pipes for potable water, heating, and industry: Mono and fibre-composite versions in all pressure classes, manufactured in Germany according to DIN 8077/8078. Available from d20 to d630 for permanently tight connections.

sticky.title: Polymer Engineering in perfection.
sticky.lead: The molecular structure of our PP-R and PPRCT pipes has been optimised for extreme thermomechanical loads. A masterpiece of German engineering.

items.title: PPRCT Multilayer Architecture
items.desc: Our next-generation PPRCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymers with modified Crystallinity and Temperature resistance) pipes feature an integrated glass fibre compound layer. This reduces the thermal linear expansion by up to 75% compared to standard PP-R pipes, while drastically increasing the compressive strength at high temperatures. Thinner wall thicknesses with increased flow capacity are the result.

items.title: Homogeneous Welding
items.desc: In contrast to press fittings or adhesive joints, we use the polyfusion welding process. Pipe and fitting fuse at 260°C into a single, inseparable molecular unit. The system operates entirely without O-rings or mechanical seals. The joint is physically stronger than the pipe itself: a 100% leak-free lifespan is guaranteed.

items.title: Absolute Freedom from Corrosion
items.desc: Metallic systems capitulate to aggressive water qualities, low pH values, or high chloride content. K Aqua polymer pipes are completely inert. Pitting, crevice corrosion, galvanic corrosion, or incrustations are physically excluded. The pipe friction loss (roughness value k=0.007 mm) remains at day one levels even after 50 years of operation, which massively reduces pump energy.

items.title: Thermal and Acoustic Insulation
items.desc: Thanks to the low thermal conductivity of PP-R (0.24 W/mK) compared to steel (50 W/mK) or copper (380 W/mK), condensation on cooling systems is significantly delayed and heat losses in heating systems are minimised. In addition, our thick-walled polymer pipes efficiently absorb flow noise and water hammers, perfecting acoustic comfort in high-rises and hotels.

timeline.title: Zero Fault Tolerance
timeline.desc: Every centimetre of our pipes is monitored in the extrusion process. From the granulate to the finished product: Quality Made in Germany.

items.title: Premium Raw Material
items.text: We exclusively process highly pure PP-R and PPRCT granules from the world's leading polymer manufacturers. Every batch undergoes an MFR test (Melt Flow Rate) and an oxidative induction time measurement (OIT) in our in-house laboratory before being released for extrusion.

items.title: Precision Extrusion
items.text: Our state-of-the-art extrusion lines manufacture 3-layer fibre composite pipes with micrometre precision. Ultrasonic wall thickness measurement in real-time over 360° ensures that the minimum permissible tolerances are exceeded, even with SDR 6 pipes.

items.title: Thermal Conditioning
items.text: Immediately after extrusion, the pipes are gradually cooled down in specially tempered water baths. This gentle cooling process prevents internal residual stresses in the material and ensures the highest dimensional accuracy across all dimensions.

items.title: 100% Traceability
items.text: Every pipe receives an indelible laser imprint with exact batch and production time details. Even after decades in the wall, the origin of every K Aqua pipe can be traced back seamlessly to the granule batch.

items.title: Testing & Approval
items.text: Hydraulic burst pressure test at 95°C for 1000 hours. Tensile tests, notched impact strength, and toxicological safety testing. Only when the product exceeds all standards (DIN 8077/8078, EN ISO 15874) does it leave our factory.

hero.title: Transition Fittings: Securely from metal to PP-R
hero.lead: Brass meets polymer: K Aqua transition fittings connect existing metal pipelines permanently tightly and corrosion-free to the PP-R system, tested well beyond the standard.

intro.title: Where worlds collide.
intro.lead: The transition from rigid metallic piping systems to modern thermoplastic networks is the Achilles nerve of every building and industrial installation. Maximum thermal and mechanical shear forces are at work here.

sticky.title: Anatomy of Indestructibility.
sticky.lead: We do not consider a transition fitting as an accessory, but as a highly complex mechanical instrument. Every millimetre of wall thickness, every thread is the result of countless Finite Element Analyses (FEA).

items.title: The Symbiosis of Metal and Polymer
items.desc: Our transition fittings combine the relentless mechanical strength of dezincification-resistant CW617N brass with the chemical inertness of PPRCT. This material fusion is not created by simple pressing, but by a thermomechanical injection moulding process that achieves an inseparable molecular interlocking.

items.title: Extreme Torsion and Torque
items.desc: A critical failure criterion for standard fittings is torque overload during installation. K Aqua transitions integrate a patented hexagonal anchoring profile in the plastic jacket. The result: Over 300 Nm guaranteed torsional resistance without delamination of the boundary layer.

items.title: Thermal Expansion Coefficients in Equilibrium
items.desc: Metals and plastics expand differently during temperature fluctuations (Δα). Thanks to precisely calculated micro-expansion joints in the brass insert, our fittings compensate for extreme shocks from -20°C to +95°C in milliseconds, absolutely leak-free.

items.title: Zero-Tolerance Quality Control
items.desc: Every single hybrid component undergoes a fully automated helium leak test and a 3D optical measurement. If the limit value of 10^-5 mbar·l/s is even slightly touched, our system rigorously rejects the part. German Engineering tolerates no compromises.

bento.title: Architecture of Performance.
bento.lead: When you plan megaprojects with tens of thousands of connections, statistical reliability is the most important ROI. K Aqua provides you with the physical guarantee for it.

items.title: DZR Brass Core
items.desc: Dezincification-resistant brass grade CW617N (according to DIN EN 12164) eliminates the risk of selective corrosion in aggressive water qualities.

items.title: Anti-Rotation Design
items.desc: Polygonal undercuts form a geometric lock that absorbs extreme tightening torques without stressing the plastic casing.

items.title: Deep-Drawn Thread
items.desc: Conical and cylindrical ISO 7/1 and ISO 228 threads, machine-cut with a tolerance of ±0.01mm for perfect sealing.

items.title: PPRCT Matrix
items.desc: The highly crystalline structure of our Polypropylene Random Copolymer offers outstanding long-term creep resistance at high temperatures.

timeline.title: The Manufacturing Cycle
timeline.desc: A look into our manufactory. The journey from raw material to tested hybrid fitting is an orchestra of heat, pressure, and ruthless precision.

items.title: Blank Machining (CW617N)
items.text: The brass is pressed into high-precision dies at 750°C, followed by CNC-controlled machining in the micrometre range to create the sealing profile.

items.title: Surface Passivation

items.text: In high-pressure injection moulding machines (2,000 bar), the molten PPRCT encloses the brass. The plastic completely fills every undercut.

items.title: Pressure & Torsion Testing
items.text: Random burst tests up to 120 bar and continuous vibration tests simulate 50 years of the most aggressive industrial endurance stress.

co2.guideText:
Sustainability and LCA (Life Cycle Assessment)

Choosing the right piping system has a significant impact on the carbon footprint of a building or industrial plant. The K-Aqua CO2 calculator enables a comprehensive life cycle assessment (LCA) in accordance with the standards of EN 15804. This analysis covers the entire life cycle: from raw material extraction and product manufacturing (phases A1-A3) via transport and installation (phases A4-A5) up to the use phase (phase B) and end-of-life (phase C).

Compared to conventional metal pipes made of copper or steel, K-Aqua PP-R and PPRCT pipes have a significantly more favourable ecological balance. The lower energy requirement for extruding the plastic and the significantly lower weight considerably reduce CO2 emissions during production and transport. Furthermore, the mirror-smooth inner surface (roughness of only 0.007 mm) ensures extremely low flow resistance. According to the Darcy-Weisbach equation, this means that circulation pumps have to use significantly less energy (electricity) to pump the fluid through the system.

Especially in the use phase (phase B), which for piping systems often lasts 50 years or more, this energy saving adds up to massive CO2 and cost savings (Total Cost of Ownership, TCO). Polypropylene also offers ecological advantages at the end of its service life (phase C), as it is 100% recyclable and can be reused in the sense of the circular economy (Module D). Use this calculator to precisely and transparently quantify the ecological and economic savings potential of your K-Aqua project.
